title: The Forceful Early Ones
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabban Gamliel was so called, as in [Sanhedrin 11b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.11b.1).[^1]

notes.text: The Gemara contrasts the earlier stern authorities with the later humble ones. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Sanhedrin.11b.1.1) explains the first expression by referring to Rabban Gamliel, and contrasts his son Rabban Shimon.
